before: A format record whose runs reached into a text insertion or deletion was planned in one group with that change, so the engine left both cards (incomplete-group): the editor alone refused the format card, and a room refused it as engine-refused.
after: The engine plans a format record apart from the text insertion or deletion its runs sit in (revision-batch visit), as Word decides them, so each card is decided on its own, in the editor alone and in a room.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format do not change. Only the verdict of such a decision changes, from refused to decided, as the engine plans it. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
